name: Recapo
summary: AI video editor that turns long footage into short clips ready to publish.
description: Recapo is an AI video editing platform. It analyzes long videos, drafts a commentary script, adds a voiceover and subtitles, and produces short clips ready to publish. The site presents it for film recaps, highlight extraction, and edits described in natural language.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free trial of the core tools is available. The pricing page says yearly tiers are shown as an averaged monthly price: Starter $9.99/mo, Basic $16.99/mo, Pro $42.99, Ultimate $86.99/mo (Ultimate also lists $99.99).

howToUse.title: Upload footage
howToUse.description: Upload a video or drop a link. The page says this is step 01.

howToUse.title: Let AI make a rough cut
howToUse.description: Step 02 on the page is an AI rough cut of the footage.

howToUse.title: Fine-tune the edit
howToUse.description: Step 03 is to refine the edit and add B-roll.

howToUse.title: Schedule publishing
howToUse.description: Step 04 is to schedule publishing of the short clips. The page says a video can be published automatically to YouTube.
